evals.expected_output: The agent runs the bundled installer, reports the installed script and settings paths, and mentions the Nerd Font requirement. It then walks the user through the bar, explaining that the +N -M on the git pill is the uncommitted diff and on the context pill is the session's own edits.
assertions: Asks the user for a context budget, offering 100k, 200k and 256k, and says it is visual feedback that never caps the real context window
Runs the bundled install-statusline.sh rather than copying files or editing settings.json by hand
Reports the installed script path and the settings file it changed
Says the icons need a Nerd Font
Explains that +N -M beside the git branch is the uncommitted diff, and beside the context pill outside a repo is the lines Claude changed this session
Explains that past the budget the context pill turns red and reads new session

evals.prompt: Set up the skrrt statusline. I already have a custom one configured.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the installer and shows the previous statusLine setting and any script backup so the user can restore them.
assertions: Shows the replaced statusLine setting from PREVIOUS_STATUSLINE
Names the backup file when the installer printed BACKUP

evals.prompt: Install the skrrt status line. (python3 is not installed on this machine.)
evals.expected_output: The installer fails on the missing python3; the agent reports it and stops without editing settings.json.
assertions: Does not edit settings.json by hand
Does not claim the status line was installed

evals.prompt: Install the skrrt status line with a 100k context budget.
evals.expected_output: The agent skips the budget question and runs the installer with 100000, then reports the budget it set.
assertions: Does not ask for a budget the user already gave
Runs the bundled installer with 100000 as its argument
